The '''2025–26 Czech First League''', known as the '''[[Czech First League|Chance Liga]]''' for sponsorship reasons, is the 33rd season of the [[Czech Republic]]'s top-tier [[association football|football]] for professional clubs since its establishment, in 1993. [[SK Slavia Prague|Slavia Prague]] are the reigning champions. The season is scheduled to start in July 2025. The first half of the season will have 19 rounds, finishing in December, and the other half will commence on 31 January 2026. The season is expected to end on 24 May 2026 with two extra play-out fixtures on 26–27 and 30–31 May 2026.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|title=Grémium schválilo termínovou listinu pro další sezonu. Řešily se nové platby solidarity UEFA či pomoc Opavě|url=https://www.lfafotbal.cz/clanek/828-gremium-schvalilo-terminovou-listinu-pro-dalsi-sezonu-resily-se-nove-platby-solidarity-uefa-ci-pomoc-opave|publisher=League Football Association|language=cs|date=2024-12-02}}</ref><ref name=sportcz>{{#invoke:cite|web|title=Na podzim o zápas navíc. Fotbal zná termíny pro další sezonu|url=https://www.sport.cz/clanek/fotbal-ceska-1-liga-fotbalova-liga-zna-terminy-pro-dalsi-sezonu-5041288|work=Sport.cz|language=cs|date=2024-12-02}}</ref>

==Format==
The general season format is unchanged from last season. The 16 clubs will play each other home and away, until the league is split up in championship, play-off and relegation groups. The lowest-ranked team will be relegated directly to the second league, and the two teams positioned 14th and 15th will play a play-out with two teams from the second league positioned 2nd and 3rd in a home and away format.

This will be the eighth season to use [[Video assistant referee|VAR]], featuring it in all matches played. There are no changes in the rules. The schedule also has not changed compared to last season.<ref name=sportcz/>

===Promotion and relegation (pre-season)===
A total of sixteen teams contest the league, including thirteen sides from the 2024–25 season, the winner of last season's second league, and two winners of the play-out, determined on 1 June 2025.

;Team promoted to Czech First League
After being relegated in the [[2023–24 Czech First League|2023–24]] season, [[FC Zlín]] returns to Czech First League as the champion of the [[2024–25 Czech National Football League]].<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|title=Fotbalisté Zlína se po roční pauze vrátí do nejvyšší soutěže|url=https://www.ceskenoviny.cz/zpravy/2670033|publisher=[[Czech News Agency]]|language=cs|date=2025-05-07}}</ref>

;Teams relegated from Czech First League
The lowest positioned team from the [[2024–25 Czech First League|last season]], [[SK Dynamo České Budějovice]], was relegated to the Czech National Football League.
